# Welcome to the `cstdtohtml` regression test suite

## IMPORTANT: READ FIRST

For legal reasons, this test suite cannot be shipped with test cases. It is up
to you to first populate it, then use it for regression testing.

To populate the test suite, place C Standard Draft PDF files in the `in/`
folder, then run `make ref` from the root of the repository.

## Architecture

* `in/`: The inputs: the C Standard Draft PDF files.
* `out/`: The outputs: the files generated by `cstdtohtml` when given each file
  in `in/`.
* `ref/`: The references: the outputs that we will compare whatever is in `out/`
  with.

## Commands

* `make check`: Generate the ouputs for each input, compare them to `ref/`.
* `make ref`: Overwrite `ref/` with the contents of `out/`.

Commands must be run from the root of the repository. Commands should be robust
to concurrency, you can speed up the processes by running with `-j`.
